'''Mohammad Ali Zolfigol''' ({{langx|fa|محمدعلی زلفی‌گل}}; born 2 February 1966) is an Iranian professor of [[chemistry]] and former [[Ministry of Science, Research and Technology (Iran)|Minister of Science, Research and Technology]] from 2021 to 2024. He was the [[Chancellor (education)#University president|President]] of [[Bu-Ali Sina University]] from August 2, 2008 to June 8, 2014. He is also a permanent member of the [[Academy of Sciences of Iran]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.irna.ir/news/85243912/%DB%B1%DB%B7-%D8%B9%D8%B6%D9%88-%D8%AC%D8%AF%DB%8C%D8%AF-%D9%81%D8%B1%D9%87%D9%86%DA%AF%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%88%D9%85-%DA%86%D9%87-%DA%A9%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%DB%8C-%D9%87%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%AF|title=۱۷ عضو جدید فرهنگستان علوم چه کسانی هستند؟|date=October 1, 2023|website=ایرنا}}</ref>
In 2022 Zolfigol had four of his research publications retracted by the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] because of concerns regarding the authenticity of chemicals used in the published studies and the reproducibility of the experiments.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Marcus |first1=Adam |title=Iran's science minister earns four retractions |url=https://retractionwatch.com/2022/10/25/irans-science-minister-earns-four-retractions/#more-125907 |website=Retraction Watch |date=25 October 2022 |publisher=Center for Scientific Integrity |access-date=2022-10-26}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Fisher |first1=Laura |title=Retraction: Design of 1-methylimidazolium tricyanomethanide as the first nanostructured molten salt and its catalytic application in the condensation reaction of various aromatic aldehydes, amides and β-naphthol compared with tin dioxide nanoparticles |journal=RSC Advances |year=2022 |volume=12 |issue=42 |page=27212 |publisher=Royal Society of Chemistry |doi=10.1039/D2RA90090D |pmid=36283020 |pmc=9510903 |s2cid=96078168 |doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Retraction Watch Database |url=http://retractiondatabase.org/RetractionSearch.aspx#?auth%3dZolfigol%252c%2bMohammad%2bAli |website=Retraction Watch |publisher=Center for Scientific Integrity |access-date=2022-10-26}}</ref>
